description: Create a new .emd document at a path that does not exist yet; never overwrites. It keeps the `packs` named and no other, and **none when omitted**: a document starts empty and holds what the person declares. Name a pack only when the work is what it is for — `development` for a project’s memory, `ledger` for their finances. With no path the user may be shown a form; otherwise ask them.

packs.description: The packs the document starts with, by id; `[]` for none. One of: `development` (a project’s memory: milestones, units, decisions, open questions, an inbox), `ledger` (personal finance, from statements, paychecks and fund reports).

path.description: Full path for the new document, ending in .emd. Omit to ask the user.

name: create_document
title: Create an Emerald document
